A "performance problem" means program behavior that is slow, unresponsive, jumpy, or not as responsive as you would expect.
The tool starts logging system events immediately after you turn on the recorder and stops when you turn it off with PMTOGGLE. A red dot displays with your graphics cursor while you're recording.

documentation.title: SHAREVIEWTYPE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether a shared view is created from the current view, model space or a layout, or created from the entire drawing.

documentation.title: SHORTCUTMENU (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether Default, Edit, and Command mode shortcut menus are available in the drawing area.

documentation.title: SHORTCUTMENUDURATION (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies how long the right button on a pointing device must be pressed to display a shortcut menu in the drawing area.

documentation.title: SHOWHIST (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the Show History property for solids in a drawing.

documentation.title: SHOWLAYERUSAGE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays icons in the Layer Properties Manager to indicate whether layers are in use.

documentation.title: SHOWMOTIONPIN (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the default state of the thumbnail images.

documentation.title: SHOWNEWSTATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether highlighting new features in updates is active.

documentation.title: SHOWPAGESETUPFORNEWLAYOUTS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies whether the Page Setup Manager is displayed when a new layout is created.

documentation.title: SHPNAME (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets a default shape name that must conform to symbol- naming conventions.

documentation.title: SIGWARN (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether a warning is presented when a file with an attached digital signature is opened.

documentation.title: SKETCHINC (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the record increment for the SKETCH command.

documentation.title: SKPOLY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether the SKETCH command generates lines, polylines, or splines.

documentation.title: SKTOLERANCE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines how closely the spline fits to the freehand sketch.

documentation.title: SKYSTATUS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines if the sky illumination is computed at render time.

documentation.title: SMOOTHMESHCONVERT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether mesh objects that you convert to 3D solids or surfaces are smoothed or faceted, and whether their faces are merged.

documentation.title: SMOOTHMESHGRID (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the maximum level of smoothness at which the underlying mesh facet grid is displayed on 3D mesh objects.

documentation.title: SMOOTHMESHMAXFACE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the maximum number of faces permitted for mesh objects.

documentation.title: SMOOTHMESHMAXLEV (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the maximum smoothness level for mesh objects.

documentation.title: SNAPANG (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the snap and grid rotation angle for the current viewport relative to the current UCS.

documentation.title: SNAPBASE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the snap and grid origin point for the current viewport relative to the current UCS.

documentation.title: SNAPGRIDLEGACY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the cursor snaps to the snap grid only when an operation is in progress.

documentation.title: SNAPISOPAIR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the isometric plane for the current viewport.

documentation.title: SNAPMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Turns the Snap mode on and off in the current viewport.

documentation.title: SNAPSTYL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the grid and grid snap to rectangular or isometric for the current viewport.

documentation.title: SNAPTYPE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the type of snap, rectangular or polar, for the current viewport.

documentation.title: SNAPUNIT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the snap spacing for the current viewport.

documentation.title: SOLIDCHECK (System Variable)
documentation.description: Turns 3D solid validation on and off for the current session.

documentation.title: SOLIDHIST (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether new composite solids retain a history of their original components.

documentation.title: SORTENTS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls object sorting in support of draw order for several operations.

documentation.title: SORTORDER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies whether the layer list is ordered using a natural sort order or ASCII values.

documentation.title: SPACESWITCH (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether model space can be accessed by double-clicking in a layout viewport.

documentation.title: SPLDEGREE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the last-used degree setting for splines and sets the default degree setting for the SPLINE command when specifying control vertices.

documentation.title: SPLFRAME (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of helixes and smoothed mesh objects.

documentation.title: SPLINESEGS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the number of line segments to be generated for each spline-fit polyline generated by the Spline option of the PEDIT command.

documentation.title: SPLINETYPE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the type of curve generated by the Spline option of the PEDIT command.

documentation.title: SPLKNOTS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the default knot option for the SPLINE command when specifying fit points.

documentation.title: SPLMETHOD (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores whether the default method used for the SPLINE command is fit points or control vertices.

documentation.title: SPLPERIODIC (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether closed splines and NURBS surfaces are generated with periodic properties to maintain the smoothest continuity at the closure point or seam.

documentation.title: SSFOUND (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the sheet set path and file name if a search for a sheet set is successful.

documentation.title: SSLOCATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the sheet set associated with a drawing is located and opened when the drawing is opened.

documentation.title: SSMAUTOOPEN (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display behavior of the Sheet Set Manager when a drawing associated with a sheet is opened.

documentation.title: SSMDETECTMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines which Sheet Set Manager is displayed when opening cloud-based DST files.

documentation.title: SSMOPENMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies how the Sheet Set Manager opens DST files stored in Forma Data Management.

documentation.title: SSMPOLLTIME (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the time interval between automatic refreshes of the status data in a sheet set.

documentation.title: SSMSHEETSTATUS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls how the status data in a sheet set is refreshed.

documentation.title: SSMSTATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the Sheet Set Manager window is open or closed.

documentation.title: STANDARDSVIOLATION (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies whether a user is notified of standards violations in the current drawing when a nonstandard object is created or modified.

documentation.title: STARTINFOLDER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the drive and folder path from where the product was started.

documentation.title: STARTMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of the Start tab.

documentation.title: STARTUP (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls what is displayed when the application is started, or when a new drawing is opened.

documentation.title: STATUSBAR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of the status bar.

documentation.title: STEPSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the size of each step when in walk or fly mode, in drawing units.

documentation.title: STEPSPERSEC (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the number of steps taken per second when you are in walk or fly mode.

documentation.title: STUDENTDRAWING (System Variable)
documentation.description: Reports whether the current drawing was saved with an Autodesk Student Version product.

documentation.title: STYLUSFORCETHRESHOLD (System Variable)
documentation.description: For those using a stylus for input, controls the force threshold which means the intensity needed to press the stylus for it to be considered a click or selection.

documentation.title: SUBOBJSELECTIONMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Filters whether faces, edges, vertices or solid history subobjects are highlighted when you roll over them.

documentation.title: SUNPROPERTIESSTATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the Sun Properties window is open or closed.

documentation.title: SUNSTATUS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Turns on and off the lighting effects of the sun in the current viewport.

documentation.title: SURFACEASSOCIATIVITY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether surfaces maintain a relationship with the objects from which they were created.

documentation.title: SURFACEASSOCIATIVITYDRAG (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the dragging preview behavior of associative surfaces.

documentation.title: SURFACEAUTOTRIM (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether surfaces are automatically trimmed when you project geometry onto them.

documentation.title: SURFACEMODELINGMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether surfaces are created as procedural surfaces or NURBS surfaces.

documentation.title: SURFTAB1 (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the number of tabulations to be generated for the RULESURF and TABSURF commands.

documentation.title: SURFTAB2 (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the mesh density in the N direction for the REVSURF and EDGESURF commands.

documentation.title: SURFTYPE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the type of surface-fitting to be performed by the Smooth option of the PEDIT command.

documentation.title: SURFU (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the surface density for PEDIT Smooth in the M direction and the U isolines density on surface objects.

documentation.title: SURFV (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the surface density for PEDIT Smooth in the N direction and the V isolines density on surface objects.

documentation.title: SYSCODEPAGE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates the system code page, which is determined by the operating system.

documentation.title: SYSFLOATING (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the dock state of the drawing file tabs.

documentation.title: SYSMON (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the defined system variable list is monitored.

documentation.title: TABLEINDICATOR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of row numbers and column letters when the In-Place Text Editor is open for editing a table cell.

documentation.title: TABLELAYER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies a default layer for new tables.

documentation.title: TABLETOOLBAR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of the Table toolbar.

documentation.title: TABMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the use of a tablet input device.

documentation.title: TARGET (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the UCS coordinates of the target point for a perspective projection in the current viewport.

documentation.title: TBCUSTOMIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether tool palette groups can be customized.

documentation.title: TBSHOWSHORTCUTS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies whether shortcuts that use the Ctrl and Alt keys are displayed in the tooltips on toolbars.

documentation.title: TDCREATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the local time and date the drawing was created.

documentation.title: TDINDWG (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the total editing time, which is the total elapsed time between saves of the current drawing.

documentation.title: TDUCREATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the universal time and date that the drawing was created.

documentation.title: TDUPDATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the local time and date of the last update/save.

documentation.title: TDUSRTIMER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the user-elapsed timer.

documentation.title: TDUUPDATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the universal time and date of the last update or save.

documentation.title: TEMPOVERRIDES (System Variable)
documentation.description: Turns temporary override keys on and off for drawing aids.

documentation.title: TEMPPREFIX (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the folder name assigned for temporary files, with a path separator appended.

documentation.title: TEXTALIGNMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the alignment option for aligned text.

documentation.title: TEXTALIGNSPACING (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the spacing option for aligned text.

documentation.title: TEXTALLCAPS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Converts all new text created by TEXT or MTEXT commands to uppercase.

documentation.title: TEXTAUTOCORRECTCAPS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Corrects common text errors that result from accidentally leaving the Caps Lock turned on.

documentation.title: TEXTED (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the user interface displayed for creating and editing single-line text.

documentation.title: TEXTEDITMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the TEXTEDIT command repeats automatically.

documentation.title: TEXTEVAL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls how text strings entered with TEXT (using AutoLISP) or with -TEXT are evaluated.

documentation.title: TEXTFILL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether TrueType fonts are filled-in for plotting.

documentation.title: TEXTGAPSELECTION (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether you can select text or mtext objects within the gaps or spaces between the characters.

documentation.title: TEXTJUSTIFY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the default justification used by the TEXT command to create single-line text.

documentation.title: TEXTLAYER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies a default layer for new text and multiline text objects in the current drawing.

documentation.title: TEXTOUTPUTFILEFORMAT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Provides Unicode options for log files.

documentation.title: TEXTQLTY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the resolution of TrueType text for plotting and rendering.

documentation.title: TEXTSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the default text height when creating new text objects.

documentation.title: TEXTSTYLE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the name of the current text style.

documentation.title: TEXTTOATTRIBUTE (System Variable)
documentation.description: In the BSEARCH command, if text objects are selected, controls whether text variations will be searched for conversion into block attributes.

documentation.title: THICKNESS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the default 3D thickness property when creating 2D geometric objects.

documentation.title: THUMBSAVE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether thumbnail preview images are saved within the drawing.

documentation.title: THUMBSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the display resolution in pixels for all thumbnail preview images.

documentation.title: THUMBSIZE2D (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies whether the size of 2D wireframe thumbnail preview is controlled by THUMBSIZE sysvar. If turned off, previews of drawings using the 2D wireframe visual styles are set to a display resolution of 256 x 256 pixels.

documentation.title: TILEMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether the Model tab or the most-recently accessed named layout tab is active.

documentation.title: TIMEZONE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the time zone for the sun in the drawing.

documentation.title: TOOLTIPMERGE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Combines drafting tooltips into a single tooltip.

documentation.title: TOOLTIPS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of tooltips on the ribbon, toolbars, and other user interface elements.

documentation.title: TOOLTIPSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the display size for drafting tooltips, and dynamic input text.

documentation.title: TOOLTIPTRANSPARENCY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the transparency for drafting tooltips.

documentation.title: TOUCHMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: For those using a touch-enabled screen or interface, controls the display of the Touch panel on the ribbon.

documentation.title: TPSTATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the Tool Palettes window is open or closed.

documentation.title: TRACECURRENT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the name of the active trace when TRACEMODE=1 or 2.

documentation.title: TRACEDISPLAYMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the tracing paper effect is displayed (front) or not (back) while a trace is active.

documentation.title: TRACEFADECTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the amount of fading when TRACEMODE is active. The setting affects only the objects not being edited - the host drawing geometry or Trace geometry.

documentation.title: TRACEMARKUPFADECTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the transparency of faded markups. The lower the number, the more visible the markup is.

documentation.title: TRACEMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether Trace is active and which mode is current - editing or viewing.

documentation.title: TRACEOSNAP (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether object snaps apply to trace geometry while viewing a trace.

documentation.title: TRACEPALETTESTATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Reports whether the Traces palette is open or closed.

documentation.title: TRACEPAPERCTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the opaqueness of the tracing paper effect.

documentation.title: TRACEVPSUPPORT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether markup assist boxes are actionable within a currently active model space viewport.

documentation.title: TRACKPATH (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of polar and object snap tracking alignment paths.

documentation.title: TRANSPARENCYDISPLAY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the transparency property assigned to individual objects or bylayer is visible or suppressed.

documentation.title: TRAYICONS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether a tray is displayed on the status bar.

documentation.title: TRAYNOTIFY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether service notifications are displayed in the status bar tray.

documentation.title: TRAYTIMEOUT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the length of time in seconds that service notifications are displayed.

documentation.title: TREEDEPTH (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the maximum depth, that is, the number of times the tree-structured spatial index can divide into branches.

documentation.title: TREEMAX (System Variable)
documentation.description: Limits memory consumption during drawing regeneration by limiting the number of nodes in the spatial index (oct-tree).

documentation.title: TRIMEDGES (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether trimming and extending to hatches with Quick mode is limited to the edges of the hatches or includes the objects within hatch patterns.

documentation.title: TRIMEXTENDMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the TRIM and EXTEND commands use streamlined inputs.

documentation.title: TRIMMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether selected edges for chamfers and fillets are trimmed.

documentation.title: TRUSTEDDOMAINS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the domain names or URLs from which AutoCAD can run JavaScript code.

documentation.title: TRUSTEDPATHS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies which folders have permission to load and execute files that contain code.

documentation.title: TSPACEFAC (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the multiline text line-spacing distance measured as a factor of text height.

documentation.title: TSPACETYPE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the type of line spacing used in multiline text.

documentation.title: TSTACKALIGN (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the vertical alignment of stacked text.

documentation.title: TSTACKSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the percentage of stacked text fraction height relative to selected text's current height.

documentation.title: UCS2DDISPLAYSETTING (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the UCS icon when the 2D Wireframe visual style is current.

documentation.title: UCS3DPARADISPLAYSETTING (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the UCS icon when perspective view is off and a 3D visual style is current.

documentation.title: UCS3DPERPDISPLAYSETTING (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the UCS icon when perspective view is on and a 3D visual style is current.

documentation.title: UCSAXISANG (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the default angle when rotating the UCS around one of its axes using the X, Y, or Z option of the UCS command.

documentation.title: UCSBASE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the name of the UCS that defines the origin and orientation of orthographic UCS settings.

documentation.title: UCSDETECT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether dynamic UCS acquisition is active when creating objects involving 3D planar surfaces.

documentation.title: UCSFOLLOW (System Variable)
documentation.description: Generates a plan view whenever you change from one UCS to another.

documentation.title: UCSICON (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the visibility and placement of the UCS icon.

documentation.title: UCSNAME (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the name of the current user coordinate system for the current viewport in the current space.

documentation.title: UCSORG (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the origin point of the current user coordinate system for the current viewport in the current space.

documentation.title: UCSORTHO (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether the XY plane of the UCS is automatically aligned with the plane of the current view when an orthographic view is restored.

documentation.title: UCSSELECTMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the UCS icon can be selected and manipulated with grips.

documentation.title: UCSVIEW (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether the current UCS is saved with a named view.

documentation.title: UCSVP (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether the UCSs in other viewports are dependent or independent of the UCS of the current viewport.

documentation.title: UCSXDIR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the X direction of the current UCS for the current viewport in the current space.

documentation.title: UCSYDIR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the Y direction of the current UCS for the current viewport in the current space.

documentation.title: UNDOCTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the options used in the UNDO command.

documentation.title: UNDOMARKS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the number of marks placed in the UNDO control stream.

documentation.title: UNITMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display format for units.

documentation.title: UOSNAP (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether object snaps are available for geometry in DWF, DWFx, PDF, and DGN underlays.

documentation.title: UPDATETHUMBNAIL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls updating of the thumbnail previews for views and layouts.

documentation.title: VIEWBACKSTATUS (System Variable)

documentation.title: VIEWCTR (System Variable)

documentation.title: VIEWDIR (System Variable)

documentation.title: VIEWFWDSTATUS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores whether a previous view is available for the VIEWFORWARD command.

documentation.title: VIEWMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the view settings for the current viewport.

documentation.title: VIEWPORTLAYER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies a default layer for new viewports.

documentation.title: VIEWSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the height of the view displayed in the current viewport, measured in drawing units.

documentation.title: VIEWSKETCHMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the system is in symbol sketch mode or not.

documentation.title: VIEWTWIST (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the view rotation angle for the current viewport measured relative to the WCS.

documentation.title: VIEWUPDATEAUTO (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether model documentation drawing views are updated automatically when the source model changes.

documentation.title: VISRETAIN (System Variable)

documentation.title: VISRETAINMODE (System Variable)

documentation.title: VSADRAFTANGLELOW (System Variable)

documentation.title: VSAZEBRASIZE (System Variable)

documentation.title: VSAZEBRATYPE (System Variable)

documentation.title: VSSTATE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the Visual Styles window is open or closed.

documentation.title: VTDURATION (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the duration of a smooth view transition, in milliseconds.

documentation.title: VTENABLE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls when smooth view transitions are used.

documentation.title: VTFPS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the minimum speed of a smooth view transition, in frames per second.

documentation.title: WBLOCKCREATEMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the behavior for selected objects after saving the blocks as a file with the WBLOCK and -WBLOCK commands.

documentation.title: WHIPARC (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls how circles and arcs are displayed.

documentation.title: WHIPTHREAD (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether to use an additional processor to improve the speed of certain operations such as those that regenerate the drawing.

documentation.title: WINDOWAREACOLOR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the color of the transparent selection area during window selection.

documentation.title: WIPEOUTFRAME (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of frames for wipeout objects.

documentation.title: WMFBKGND (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the background display when objects are inserted in Windows metafile (WMF) format.

documentation.title: WMFFOREGND (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the assignment of the foreground color when objects are inserted in Windows metafile (WMF) format.

documentation.title: WORKINGFOLDER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Stores the drive and folder path of the operating system's working folder for the process, which can be of interest to developers.

documentation.title: WORKSPACELABEL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether to display the name of the current workspace in the status bar.

documentation.title: WORLDUCS (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether the UCS is coincident with the WCS.

documentation.title: WORLDVIEW (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether input to the DVIEW and VPOINT commands is relative to the WCS (default) or the current UCS.

documentation.title: WRITESTAT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Indicates whether a drawing file is read-only or can be revised.

documentation.title: WSAUTOSAVE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Saves changes you made to a workspace when you switch to another workspace.

documentation.title: WSCURRENT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Displays the current workspace name at the Command prompt and sets a specified workspace to be the current one.

documentation.title: XCLIPFRAME (System Variable)
documentation.description: Determines whether xref clipping boundaries are visible or plotted in the current drawing.

documentation.title: XCOMPAREBAKPATH (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies the path where the backup xref file is stored.

documentation.title: XCOMPAREBAKSIZE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Sets the size of the folder where the backup xref file is stored.

documentation.title: XCOMPARECOLORMODE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Switches the visual effect of objects in the host drawing during an xref comparison.

documentation.title: XCOMPAREENABLE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Enables the comparison between an xref and the referenced drawing file.

documentation.title: XDWGFADECTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the dimming for all DWG xref objects.

documentation.title: XEDIT (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the current drawing can be edited in-place when being referenced by another drawing.

documentation.title: XFADECTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the amount of fading within a reference being edited in place. This setting affects only the objects that are not being edited in the reference.

documentation.title: XLOADCTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Turns xref demand-loading on and off, and controls whether it opens the referenced drawing or a copy.

documentation.title: XLOADPATH (System Variable)
documentation.description: Creates a path for storing temporary copies of demand-loaded xref files.

documentation.title: XREFCTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether external reference log (XLG) files are created.

documentation.title: XREFLAYER (System Variable)
documentation.description: Specifies a default layer for a new xref.

documentation.title: XREFNOTIFY (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the notification for updated or missing xrefs.

documentation.title: XREFOVERRIDE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the display of object properties on referenced layers.

documentation.title: XREFREGAPPCTL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls whether the registered application (RegApp) records stored in an xref being loaded are copied to the host drawing.

documentation.title: XREFTYPE (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls the default reference type when attaching or overlaying an external reference.

documentation.title: ZOOMFACTOR (System Variable)
documentation.description: Controls how much the magnification changes when the mouse wheel moves forward or backward.

documentation.title: ZOOMWHEEL (System Variable)
documentation.description: Toggles the direction of transparent zoom operations when you scroll the middle mouse wheel.
